var_dir.description: Base directory for Mailman’s persistent data (archives, lists, etc.)

pid_file.description: Path to the master process PID file

default_language.description: Default language code for new users and list messages (e.g., 'en', 'fr')

outgoing_charset.description: Default character set for outgoing email messages

email_host.description: Default domain suffix for list addresses (e.g., 'lists.example.com' → lists@lists.example.com)

web_host.description: Public hostname used for the web UI and list pages

list_max_members.description: Maximum number of members allowed per mailing list

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for messages accepted from posters (default: 10 MB)

subscription_policy.description: Policy for new subscriptions: 'confirm' (email confirmation), 'notify' (admin notified), 'moderate' (admin approval required), 'direct' (auto-approve), or 'digest'

post_hold_policy.description: Policy for posts from non-members: 'moderate' (hold for approval), 'reject' (discard), 'discard' (discard silently), or 'accept' (allow)

auto_subscribe.description: Whether to auto-subscribe a poster’s email address if they post but are not yet a list member

require_subject.description: Whether to reject posts lacking a Subject: header

footer_msg.description: Footer text appended to every outgoing list message (leave empty to disable)

api_rate_limit.description: Maximum number of REST API requests per minute per IP (for rate limiting)

password_reset_timeout.description: Time window (in seconds) during which a password reset token is valid

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname for outgoing mail

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (587 for submission, 465 for SMTPS, 25 for unencrypted)

smtp_user.description: SMTP username (leave empty if no authentication needed)

smtp_pass.description: SMTP password (store securely in production — e.g., via secrets manager)
